about.title: About Daaru Kutubul Athaariyyah
about.subtitle: Bringing authentic Islamic knowledge to your doorstep since 2020.
about.story: Daaru Kutubul Athaariyyah (House of Books on the Athar) began in 2020 as a small weekend stall in Lagos, with a handful of carefully chosen books and a simple belief: authentic Islamic knowledge should be easy to find, fairly priced, and delivered with care. Word spread, and what started as a stall grew into a nationwide online bookstore serving readers across all 36 states — yet every title is still hand-picked and verified the same way it was on day one.
about.mission: To make authentic Islamic literature accessible to every home — carefully selected, fairly priced, and delivered with care.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use and protect your personal information.

intro.title: Overview
intro.text: Daaru Kutubul Athaariyyah respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you browse or shop with us, how it is used, and the choices you have.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.text: We collect the information you provide when you place an order or contact us — your name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and order details. We also collect limited technical data (such as your browser type) to keep the site working.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.text: Your information is used to process and deliver orders, respond to enquiries, send order updates, and — only with your consent — occasional newsletters about new arrivals and offers.

sharing.title: Sharing Your Information
sharing.text: We never sell your personal information. We share only what is necessary with trusted partners who help us run the store (payment processing and delivery), and only to the extent needed to provide our services.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We use cookies and local storage to remember your language preference and keep items in your shopping cart. You can clear these at any time from your browser settings.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: You may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. To make a request, contact us using the details on the Contact page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.text: Questions about this policy? Email {{email}} or call {{phone}}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The terms that govern your use of Daaru Kutubul Athaariyyah.

intro.title: Agreement
intro.text: By using the Daaru Kutubul Athaariyyah website, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree with any part of them, please do not use the site.

orders.title: Placing Orders
orders.text: All orders are subject to availability and confirmation. An order is confirmed once we have accepted it and (where applicable) received payment. We reserve the right to decline or cancel an order at any time.

pricing.title: Pricing & Payment
pricing.text: Prices are listed in Nigerian Naira (NGN) and include applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. Payment is processed securely by Flutterwave via card, bank transfer or USSD.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.text: We deliver nationwide. Delivery times are estimates and may vary. Risk of loss passes to you once the order is delivered to the address you provided.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.text: If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us within 7 days of delivery and we will replace it or refund you in full, no questions asked.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Daaru Kutubul Athaariyyah is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from the use of this site or the products purchased.

changes.title: Changes to These Terms
changes.text: We may update these terms from time to time. The latest version will always be published on this page, and continued use of the site means you accept the updated terms.
